title: Add recent closed-work query command
description: Expose a first-class read-only CLI query for recently closed work so reviewer agents can inspect completed tasks, issues, phases, sprints, and containers without scraping local operation history.
acceptanceCriteria: Command returns closed work sorted by closedAt with id, title, kind, status, closedAt, closedReason, labels, evidence count, and verification count.
Container scope uses dependency graph descendants; phase support handles milestone records carrying the phase label.
Implementation reads durable work records and work.closed events, not prunable local operation history, as the source of truth.
Checkpoint outcome is recorded as a scoped commit or dirty-path reason code before closeout.
closedReason: recent closed work query command implemented and verified
